structure: Every visible line has one text element with one top-level tspan.
Each heading, lyric and translation, glossary pair, photo with captions, back-to-then annotation, closing refrain, credit, and wind decoration has a distinct data-entrance-group.
Mixed Korean / Latin lyrics use an independent smaller Latin text element at the same baseline, following the Korean text in the DOM.
Quoted lyrics use separate open and close poster-quote paths; order is open, Korean, inline Latin if present, close, translation.
Photo transforms remain on outer groups and photo-float is the inner group.
Backing papers and tapes carry data-photo-for to associate them with photos.
differences: Authored Latin copy is lowercased. The original downloadable poster and photo pixels are unmodified.
SVG baselines approximate AppKit paragraph layout; browser font shaping, fallback glyphs, and fractional advances may differ by a few pixels.
The source uses 36,000 deterministic paper-grain dots; SVG uses a repeating subtle native dot pattern.
Photo shadows use feDropShadow instead of AppKit NSShadow.
No JavaScript, CSS animation, generated handwriting paths, or photo manipulation is included.
